name: Xantcha
description: A Phyrexian newt sleeper agent who rebelled against Phyrexia, befriended Urza, and sacrificed herself at Koilos.

timeline.summary: Xantcha is created at the Fane of Flesh as a Phyrexian sleeper agent.
timeline.quote: The Fane of Flesh on the Fourth Sphere of Phyrexia was where Xantcha and several other hundreds of newts of her pod were created.

citation.text: "Xantcha", section "Creation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xantcha is sent to the First Sphere to be taught how to survive on her target plane; she begins to think for herself.
timeline.quote: she thought for herself.

citation.text: "Xantcha", section "Creation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xantcha meets Gix, receives her name and chooses a female identity as rebellion; he fails to break her mind.
timeline.quote: Xantcha thus had gained both her name and her gender from her first meeting with Gix.

citation.text: "Xantcha", section "Creation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The first newts are found out and killed by Dominaria's inhabitants, and assignments stop; Xantcha is forgotten.
timeline.quote: Xantcha, largely forgotten, waited for an assignment that never came.

citation.text: "Xantcha", section "Creation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Shard of Twelve Worlds closes Phyrexia off from Dominaria, and Yawgmoth harshly punishes Gix as Xantcha watches.
timeline.quote: For this oversight, Gix was harshly punished by Yawgmoth with a grand display that Xantcha personally observed.

citation.text: "Xantcha", section "Creation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xantcha betrays Phyrexia while working as a relic seeker, destroying or booby-trapping artifacts.
timeline.quote: she usurped her role by destroying or booby-trapping the artifacts instead.

citation.text: "Xantcha", section "Travel with Urza". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza rescues Xantcha from Phyrexian executioners and she tells him how to reach Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: He rescued Xantcha from her executioners and, in return, Xantcha told Urza how to get to Phyrexia.

citation.text: "Xantcha", section "Travel with Urza". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza attacks the returned Phyrexians and follows them home, beginning his Assault on Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Urza attacked, and followed the fleeing Phyrexians to their home plane, starting Urza's Assault on Phyrexia .

citation.text: "Xantcha", section "Travel with Urza". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth halts Urza and assaults his mind; Xantcha gets her life matrix, shakes Urza from his stupor and he planeswalks them away.
timeline.quote: he planeswalked them away to safety.

citation.text: "Xantcha", section "Travel with Urza". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza and Xantcha settle on Moag for decades until Xantcha finds oil in a temple and Urza destroys it.
timeline.quote: Urza blasted the temple, destroying most of the Phyrexians

citation.text: "Xantcha", section "Travel with Urza". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Serra heals Urza at Serra's Realm; Phyrexians track them down and they escape to Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Urza and Xantcha planeswalked to Dominaria, escaping the destruction.

citation.text: "Xantcha", section "Travel with Urza". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xantcha frees Ratepe and sends him to help Urza regain his sanity.
timeline.quote: She found a slave that looked like Mishra (named Ratepe ) and paid for his freedom.

citation.text: "Xantcha", section "Sacrifice at Koilos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xantcha discovers the praetor Gix in a crypt while planting screaming spiders against sleeper agents.
timeline.quote: she went into a crypt where she discovered the praetor Gix.

citation.text: "Xantcha", section "Sacrifice at Koilos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza and Gix fight at Koilos; Xantcha and Ratepe sacrifice themselves, letting Urza defeat Gix.
timeline.quote: The disruption made Gix pause and gave Urza the chance to defeat him.

citation.text: "Xantcha", section "Sacrifice at Koilos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza later uses Xantcha's Phyrexian Heartstone as the personality core of Karn.
timeline.quote: Urza would later use Xantcha's Phyrexian Heartstone as the personality core for his silver golem Karn .

citation.text: "Xantcha", section "Sacrifice at Koilos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xantcha is sentenced to death by Phyrexia but rescued by Urza.
timeline.quote: she was rescued by Urza and joined his crusade.

citation.text: Xantcha (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Xantcha is created in the Fourth Sphere as a sleeper agent; Gix opens her mind; she sabotages missions and is saved from execution by Urza.
timeline.quote: Xantcha is created as a newt in the Fourth of Nine Spheres to be a sleeper agent sent to Dominaria.

citation.text: "Planeswalker (novel)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza enters Phyrexia with a dragon engine and destroys swaths of it; Xantcha recovers her heart and tells him to planeswalk away.
timeline.quote: Xantcha follows him and recovers her heart from the Fourth Sphere

citation.text: "Planeswalker (novel)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Pursued by Phyrexian negators, Urza and Xantcha flee across planes and land in Serra's Realm, where Serra helps Urza recover.
timeline.quote: There Urza recovers with the help of the plane's white planeswalker creator Serra.

citation.text: "Planeswalker (novel)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xantcha gives Urza her heart to show loyalty; the Shard is broken and Urza brings Xantcha to Dominaria in 3210 AR.
timeline.quote: Eventually, the Shard is broken and Urza brings Xantcha to Dominaria in 3210 AR.

citation.text: "Planeswalker (novel)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xantcha finds Ratepe to impersonate Mishra to shake Urza from his stupor; Urza plans to expose sleepers with spiders.
timeline.quote: Xantcha finds a man who physically resembles Mishra, a slave named Ratepe

citation.text: "Planeswalker (novel)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Koilos Xantcha and Ratepe discover that the Phyrexians were Thran who rebelled and were cast out of Dominaria.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexians were actually Thran that rebelled and were then cast out from Dominaria.

citation.text: "Planeswalker (novel)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Glimmer Moon activates the spiders, killing nearby sleepers, and Urza chases Gix to Koilos.
timeline.quote: The Moon activates the spiders and all the nearby sleepers are affected and killed.

citation.text: "Planeswalker (novel)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xantcha and Ratepe free Urza's powerstones, which destroy Gix; both are lost in the explosion.
timeline.quote: Ratepe and Xantcha are lost in the explosion.

citation.text: "Planeswalker (novel)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza awakens, finds Xantcha and Ratepe gone, and resolves to go to the past, remembering he has Xantcha's heart.
timeline.quote: remembers Xantcha's heart and realizes that he will never be alone

citation.text: "Planeswalker (novel)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Serra tells Urza that Xantcha is recovering and her magic would have killed her.
timeline.quote: Xantcha is recovering.

citation.text: Healing Salve (Urza's Saga, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Xantcha warns Urza that Phyrexians in human skin are everywhere.
timeline.quote: They are the sleeper agents, and they are everywhere.

citation.text: Darkest Hour (Urza's Saga, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Urza thinks he is on a crusade while Xantcha knows it is a robbery.
timeline.quote: Urza thought it a crusade. Xantcha knew it was a robbery.

citation.text: Ill-Gotten Gains (Urza's Saga, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gix silences Xantcha.
timeline.quote: Do not presume to speak for yourself.

citation.text: Oppression (Urza's Saga, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Xantcha defies Gix.
timeline.quote: then you'll never control me.

citation.text: Unnerve (Urza's Saga, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: A priest casts Xantcha down and calls to scrap her.
timeline.quote: The priest cast Xantcha to the ground.

citation.text: Victimize (Urza's Saga, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Urza and Xantcha travel to Equilor seeking the origin of the Phyrexians, taking over a thousand years to find it.
timeline.quote: It took them far more than a thousand years to find the plane.

citation.text: "Equilor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza and Barrin create Karn as a time-travel probe, giving him sentience with Xantcha's heartstone.
timeline.quote: Karn was created as a probe by Urza and Barrin to enable their time-travel experiments.

citation.text: "Karn", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xantcha and Ratepe visit Koilos; Xantcha reads Thran glyphs and learns the Thran and Phyrexians share origins.
timeline.quote: She realized the Thran and the Phyrexians had common origins, and that Gix had been one of them.

citation.text: "Koilos", section "Urza and Xantcha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xantcha and Ratepe sacrifice themselves so Urza can defeat Gix in the Sacrifice at Koilos.
timeline.quote: Xantcha and Ratepe sacrificed themselves so that Urza could defeat Gix.

citation.text: "Koilos", section "Urza and Xantcha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza and Xantcha assault Phyrexia, blasting a hole to the Fourth Sphere before being driven off by Yawgmoth.
timeline.quote: Urza blasted a giant hole in the plane down to the Fourth Sphere

citation.text: "Phyrexia", section "The return of Gix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza defeats Gix at Koilos with the help of Xantcha and Ratepe, both of whom are killed.
timeline.quote: both Xantcha and Ratepe were killed

citation.text: "Phyrexia", section "The return of Gix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza attacks Phyrexia, blasts a hole down to the 4th Sphere, but Yawgmoth invades his mind and drives him further insane.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth himself invaded his mind and made him go even more insane

citation.text: "Urza", section "Exploring the Origins of Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xantcha brings Ratepe to impersonate Mishra to shock Urza out of his guilt.
timeline.quote: Ratepe was able to help shock Urza out of his guilt.

citation.text: "Urza", section "Returning home". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xantcha and Ratepe are killed when Urza fights Gix in Koilos; the sacrifice helps Urza defeat Gix.
timeline.quote: Both Ratepe and Xantcha were killed when Urza fought the Phyrexian Demon Gix in Koilos .

citation.text: "Urza", section "Returning home". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza creates Karn by implanting Xantcha's heartstone in a silver golem.
timeline.quote: By implanting Xantcha's heartstone (her only remains) into a silver golem , Urza created Karn

citation.text: "Urza", section "Tolaria and the Time Streams". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Reborn a planeswalker, Urza attacks Phyrexia and blasts a hole to the 4th Sphere; Yawgmoth invades his mind and Urza flees.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth himself invaded his mind and made him go even more insane.

citation.text: "Yawgmoth", section "Sleeper agents". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karn creates Mirrodin and inadvertently drips Phyrexian oil on it, leaving Memnarch as guardian.
timeline.quote: he inadvertently dripped a small amount of the corrupting Phyrexian oil on his perfect world

citation.text: "Phyrexia", section "Phyrexia on Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza and Xantcha spent a few peaceful decades on Moag.
timeline.quote: Urza and his traveling companion Xantcha spent a few peaceful decades there

citation.text: "The Planes of Planechase". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Karn flung himself to Mirrodin and surrendered his spark for Dominaria; his mind came unhinged and Phyrexia's influence grew in him.
timeline.quote: Karn flung himself to Mirrodin, the metal world he once created as Argentum, while simultaneously surrendering his planeswalker spark for the sake of the plane of Dominaria.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Machine Orthodoxy
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Machine Orthodoxy". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Xantcha defies Gix, telling him fear will never control her.
timeline.quote: then you'll never control me

citation.text: Unnerve (Conspiracy: Take the Crown, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Urza destroys the sleeper agents of Gulmany, and Gix flees to Koilos for a final battle with Urza.
timeline.quote: Urza followed him there, and Gix engaged him in a climactic final battle.

citation.text: "Gix", section "Final incursion and downfall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xantcha and Ratepe sacrifice themselves to disrupt Gix's temporal shift, which implodes on him and annihilates him.
timeline.quote: causing it to implode upon Gix in a blinding inferno and annihilate him at last.

citation.text: "Gix", section "Final incursion and downfall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In 4562 AR Jodah opens the Starfield Orb and is greeted by constructs of Mishra and Xantcha.
timeline.quote: constructs of Mishra and Xantcha , who greeted Jodah

citation.text: "Mishra", section "Simulacrum". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In 4562 AR Jodah opens the Starfield Orb and is greeted by constructs of Xantcha and Mishra.
timeline.quote: In 4562 AR, Jodah opened the Starfield Orb left by Urza.

citation.text: "Xantcha", section "Simulacrum". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah meets constructs of Xantcha and Mishra, who accept him as a descendant of Urza.
timeline.quote: My name is Jodah, friend of Teferi's and descendant of Urza,

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 2: Antiquities" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Xantcha is created from Mishra's flesh as a sleeper agent for Phyrexia's invasion.
timeline.quote: Xantcha is created from Mishra 's flesh

citation.text: "Timeline/The Brothers' War", section "Aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xantcha and Ratepe cross the Sea of Laments to the Wastes and meet a goatherd who points them toward Koilos.
timeline.quote: Xantcha and Ratepe came to the Adarkar Wastes

citation.text: "Adarkar Wastes", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A meeting of planeswalkers on Gastal was interrupted by an unseen attack, killing Manatarqua; Urza abandoned his plans there.
timeline.quote: the planeswalker Manatarqua was killed.

citation.text: "Gastal", section "Pre-Mending". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xantcha purchases Ratepe in Medran to pose as Mishra before Urza.
timeline.quote: purchased him from a slaver to take him back with her to Urza

citation.text: "Ratepe", section "Travel with Xantcha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ratepe and Xantcha fall in love and Urza supports the relationship.
timeline.quote: a blossoming romance between the two

citation.text: "Ratepe", section "Travel with Xantcha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ratepe and Xantcha sacrifice themselves at Koilos so Urza can defeat Gix.
timeline.quote: they had to sacrifice themselves, and so they did

citation.text: "Ratepe", section "Sacrifice at Koilos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Locked out of Dominaria, Urza wanders the multiverse, meets Xantcha, learns where Phyrexia is and resolves to assault it.
timeline.quote: he resolved to perform an all-out assault on the plane

citation.text: "Urza's Assault on Phyrexia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xantcha enters the Fane of Flesh, finds her own heart in the pool of hearts and returns to Urza.
timeline.quote: she waded into the pool of hearts and collected it before rushing back to Urza

citation.text: "Urza's Assault on Phyrexia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Xantcha snaps Urza out of his stupor; he flees Phyrexia with her, leaving the engine.
timeline.quote: He realized that the assault had failed

citation.text: "Urza's Assault on Phyrexia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
